announcements.title: Q3 town hall — Thursday, 4:30 PM
announcements.body:
Our quarterly town hall is this Thursday at 4:30 PM in the Bengaluru atrium, streamed live for remote teammates.

We’ll walk through Q3 results, share what we learned from the Nimbus Studio beta, and open the floor for questions. Send anything you’d like covered to people@nimbuslabs.com by Wednesday noon.

Snacks and filter coffee after the session. Recording and notes will be shared on Friday.

announcements.title: Updated hybrid work policy
announcements.body:
Starting next month, everyone on a hybrid schedule will have three anchor days in office — Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday. Mondays and Fridays stay flexible.

The change came out of the workplace survey and the leadership offsite. Teams that need a different rhythm can request a variance through their manager; we’ll review those weekly.

You can read the full policy in the People handbook. Questions are welcome in the #people-ops channel or directly with anyone on the People team.

announcements.title: Wellness week is here — 20 to 24 October
announcements.body:
Five days, five small ways to reset. We’re running desk yoga, a sleep workshop, a no-meeting afternoon, eye check-ups and a guided walk through Cubbon Park.

Sign-ups are open on the events board — each session has limited seats. Remote teammates get access to the recorded workshops and a ₹1,500 wellness reimbursement for the week.

Take the time. The work will be there on Monday, and so will you.

announcements.title: New health insurance cards are on the way
announcements.body:
Our insurance partner has reissued cards with the updated family floater limit of ₹10 lakh. Physical cards should reach your registered address within 10 days.

Digital cards are already available in the benefits portal. If your dependents or address changed in the last year, please update them before the 25th so the next payroll run picks it up.

announcements.title: Nimbus turns six 🎉
announcements.body:
Six years ago we started with three people, one whiteboard and a very optimistic roadmap. Today we are 24 people shipping products used by teams in 14 countries.

Join us on the terrace at 6 PM for cake and a short photo walk down memory lane. Bring your favourite Nimbus moment — we’re collecting them for a wall in the lobby.

trainings.title: Leading hybrid teams
trainings.description: A practical programme for people managers on running distributed rituals, giving feedback across time zones, and keeping trust high when the hallway is a Slack channel.

trainings.title: Workplace POSH awareness
trainings.description: Annual mandatory training covering the POSH Act, reporting channels, and the role each of us plays in keeping the workplace safe and respectful.

trainings.title: Advanced React patterns
trainings.description: Composition, render props, Suspense and the patterns behind the Nimbus design system. Includes three hands-on code labs and a capstone review.

trainings.title: Data storytelling with BI
trainings.description: Turn dashboards into decisions. Covers narrative structure, chart selection, annotation and reviewing a metric with a skeptical stakeholder.

trainings.title: Effective 1:1 conversations
trainings.description: A 90-minute clinic on structuring check-ins, coaching through problems, and handling the conversations we tend to avoid.

trainings.title: Information security essentials
trainings.description: Passwords, phishing, device hygiene and data handling. A short annual refresher that keeps our customers’ data safe.
